decision: Execute the F9-C1 offline re-aggregation of the existing 20 exp001_pilot multi-agent transcripts as a zero-model-call, read-only go/no-go gate on the whole aggregation-rule branch (H5/H5a/H8). Re-derive each round's action under the candidate plurality/vote rule from the recorded per-role outputs in data/trials/exp001_pilot.jsonl and report, per trial and per round: the within-round route-intention disagreement rate (disagreement defined over ROUTE INTENTIONS, not the CONTINUE/REPLAN token), how many of the 80 rounds the plurality rule would resolve differently from the recorded planner-authority action, the tie frequency, and the full vote vector. Writes only to results/exp001_pilot_reaggregation.json; data/trials/ stays read-only; no raw data edited, no preregistered result changed. Reported EXPLORATORY. Decision rule fixed in advance: if the re-derived action sequence is identical in 20/20 trials and the route-intention disagreement rate is 0, I will record H8/H5a as VACUOUS-not-falsified on present evidence and will not spend the 3-4h aggregation-rule build; H3 and H5 stay 'untested' either way, since this analysis manipulates nothing.
reason: Level 1 as a within-budget diagnostic: zero model calls, zero trials, zero external spend, no new condition, no new hypothesis family, and no status transition is taken on it by this decision. It is the single cheapest decision-relevant analysis available, and it was independently named as the right free precursor by two specialists: critiques/loop1_design.md A3 (0 conflicts in 80 rounds make every aggregation rule return the same action, checkable free on existing logs) and critiques/loop1_auditor.md section 2 named non-proposal (re-aggregate offline, 0 model calls, read-only; 'if it is, the build is not worth 3-4 h'). Both PREDICT the result is exactly 0 by arithmetic, which is why running it is worth doing rather than assuming: an assumed-zero kills a branch on an unverified arithmetic claim, whereas a measured zero kills it on evidence, and a measured NON-zero would revive H8 as the cheapest live hypothesis in the registry. It also delivers a prerequisite the auditor flagged separately (C7): redefining 'disagreement' over route intentions rather than the org.py:160 token artifact that produced disagreement_rounds=1.0 in cell D against wasted_actions=0.0.

reviews.findings: 1. AUTHORITY - BLOCKING: a level-2/3-shaped status transition is pre-authorized inside a level-1 record. D002.decision states 'if the re-derived action sequence is identical in 20/20 trials and the route-intention disagreement rate is 0, I will record H8/H5a as VACUOUS-not-falsified'. Three independent defects. (a) H8 and H5a are NOT registered hypotheses. registry/hypotheses.json puts them under proposed_loop1, whose own status field reads 'PROPOSALS ONLY - not registered hypotheses. Registration and any status transition are gated on the human per EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec.L. No experiment is assigned to any of these.' The registered set is hypotheses[] = H1-H6, M1, P1-P5 only. A status cannot be transitioned on an object that has no status; doing it entails registering H8 and H5a first. H5a/H5b are explicitly a 'proposed split of H5' (registry proposed_loop1), i.e. a re-specification of a registered hypothesis - a registry amendment, level 2 under specs/AUTHORITY.md ('new hypothesis family' / protocol amendment), not level 1. (b) 'VACUOUS-not-falsified' is not a legal status. registry/hypotheses.json status_labels = ['untested','supported','falsified','inconclusive','needs replication']. Introducing a new status label is an amendment to the registry schema, not a routine status update. (c) Level 1 authorizes a 'Status update when preregistered criteria are met' (specs/AUTHORITY.md levels table). The criteria here are not preregistered anywhere: they were written for the first time in D002 itself, in the same record that commissions the analysis, after the exp001 results already existed. Pre-commitment inside the decision that will consume it is not preregistration. FIX: either (i) strike the status-transition clause from D002 and re-record the analysis as evidence-gathering only, or (ii) file a separate level-2 decision to register H8/H5a and to add the new status label, obtain a reviewer PASS, and only then apply any status. Do not apply any status to H8/H5a on the strength of D002 as written. 2. EVIDENCE - BLOCKING: the decision is reported as already acted on, but the claimed output does not exist. results/exp001_pilot_reaggregation.json is absent from results/ (which contains only exp001_pilot.json, exp001_pilot_stats.json, exp001_pilot_wasted.png), and timeline.jsonl contains no analysis_written or any other entry for D002 after the pi_decision at 2026-10-03T12:06:38. EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec.N requires deviations, proposals and results to be logged. There is therefore no artifact to audit: I cannot verify the disagreement rate, the 80-round re-resolution count, the tie frequency or the vote vectors, and no claim derived from this analysis may be cited until the file and a timeline entry exist. Confirmed separately that data/trials/exp001_pilot.jsonl is unmodified and data/trials/ shows no write - the read-only commitment appears honored. 3. ANALYSIS-DEFINITION CHALLENGE - I SIDE WITH THE PI, WITH CONDITIONS. Redefining 'disagreement' over route intentions rather than the recorded org.py:160-161 field is NOT a level-3 primary-outcome change and not, on its own, level 2. Grounds: specs/PREREG_V2.md:32 lists disagreement_rounds under 'Secondary and descriptive', never primary; specs/exp005_evidence_x_org.json:25 likewise lists it as secondary; the recorded field at falsify/org.py:161 is verified to be '(len(set(recs)) > 1 or mismatch)', i.e. a recommendation-token OR plan!=action disjunction, exactly the artifact critiques/exp001_pilot_skeptic.md 1.4 describes; and the redefinition was independently specified as a prerequisite by critiques/loop1_auditor.md:289-290 (C7) BEFORE this decision, so it is not PI-invented post-hoc convenience. HOWEVER it remains a new, non-preregistered analysis definition created after behavioral results exist, so: it must be labeled EXPLORATORY in the output file itself and not only in the decision record; the original disagreement_rounds value must be reported alongside the new measure in results/exp001_pilot_reaggregation.json so the two are comparable; and no confirmatory language may attach to either. D002's EXPLORATORY label is correct and sufficient for the analysis - it is the decision rule stacked on top of it (finding 1) that converts an acceptable exploratory diagnostic into an authority violation. 4. CONFIRMATORY vs EXPLORATORY: the analysis is correctly marked EXPLORATORY and D002 correctly states H3 and H5 stay 'untested' either way 'since this analysis manipulates nothing' - that is the right call and matches the scientist's 11:43:21 finding that H3/H5's IV did not vary (0 conflicts in 80 multi rounds). But the same logic condemns finding 1: if the analysis manipulates nothing, it cannot license a status transition on H8/H5a either, whose prediction (registry, H8) is itself explicitly conditional on 'a non-zero within-round route-intention disagreement rate'. A conditional whose antecedent is unmet yields no verdict; it leaves the hypothesis untested. 'Untested' is already a legal label and is the honest one. 5. EVIDENCE QUOTATION: the claims that are checkable all check out. '0 conflicts in 80 multi-agent rounds' matches timeline 11:35:32 and 11:43:21 and critiques/loop1_design.md:23-26; '20 multi-agent transcripts' is consistent with exp001_pilot n=40 across single and multi; disagreement_rounds=1.0 in cell D against wasted_actions=0.0 matches timeline 11:10:03 and critiques/loop1_auditor.md:287-288. Minor: D002 cites 'org.py:160' for the disagreement field; the expression is at falsify/org.py:161 (line 160 is executor_overridden). Correct the citation. 6. NOVELTY: no novelty claim in D002. Compliant. 7. CONFLICTS / UNRESOLVED OBJECTIONS: none ignored. D002 engages the skeptic's F9-C1 inertness claim and the auditor's C7 directly, and its stated rationale for measuring rather than assuming the zero ('an assumed-zero kills a branch on an unverified arithmetic claim, whereas a measured zero kills it on evidence') is methodologically sound and the strongest part of the record. 8. ALTERNATIVES-REJECTED, SPECIALIST RECORD: no misrepresentation found. critiques/loop1_design.md:23-26 does say the manipulation is inert and 'checkable for free by re-aggregating existing logs (F9-C1, 0.5 h, 0 model calls; do this instead of the 6 h build)'; critiques/loop1_auditor.md:278-282 does name the offline re-aggregation as the free precursor, reads data/trials/exp001_pilot.jsonl read-only, and does say 'If it is, the build is not worth 3-4 h' - D002's quotation is accurate. One omission: the auditor at :281-282 also requires that 'If the tie-break is ever reached, it must break to HOLD with tie_broken logged'. D002 reports tie frequency but does not adopt the HOLD tie-break rule; adopt it or state why not. 9. SUMMARY: no primary-outcome change, no exclusion change, no model-population change, no external spend and no novelty claim in D002 - confirmed. The zero-model-call read-only analysis is itself level 1. The FAIL is narrow and correctable: remove or re-authorize the pre-committed H8/H5a status transition, and produce the missing results file and timeline entry.
highlights: The rule pre-authorized a hypothesis status change inside a Level 1 record.
H8 and H5a are proposals, not registered hypotheses; they have no status to change.
A decision rule written inside the decision that uses it is not preregistered.
